screen.yujiancraft.guide.title: Yujian Guide
guide.yujiancraft.page.0.title: Spirit Ore and Crystals
guide.yujiancraft.page.0.body: Spirit Ore generates underground in the Overworld, with a deepslate form at lower levels. Mine it with iron tier or better. Fortune improves drops and Silk Touch preserves the ore. Spirit Crystals are used by every flying sword, workstation and tempering recipe.
guide.yujiancraft.page.1.title: Forging Flying Swords
guide.yujiancraft.page.1.body: Place a vanilla sword in the center, matching material on the four cardinal slots, and Spirit Crystals in the corners. Surround a base flying sword with eight more crystals for the longer Spiritforged series. Tooltips show current per-pierce damage and temper count.
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.title: Formations and Recall
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.body: Press V to summon or recall the formation. Ctrl+R cycles the aligned fan, ring and side-on fan. A sword must dock before its next sortie; the server controls minimum dock time. Blade tips track their flight direction.
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.title: Targeting and Combat
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.body: Crosshair Lock is the default: hold a flying sword and left-click near a target; the same click still performs melee. The marker remains until that target dies or you lock another, whether the formation is deployed or recalled. Ctrl+I selects Automatic or Spirit-Sense control.
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.title: Sword Riding
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.body: With any usable flying sword in your inventory, double-tap jump to enter or leave sword riding. Move horizontally, jump to rise and sneak to descend. Riding uses a separate support sword and never consumes the combat formation. Camera and brightness options are under Ctrl+I.
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.title: Flying Sword Workbench
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.body: Install or remove flame, lightning, blight, burst, arrow-rain, edge, durability, unbreakable and molten cores. Material counts 1, 16 and 64 produce levels I, II and III. Modules are normally reversible, but entering tempering again disperses every installed Yujian core.
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.title: Myriad Flying Swords
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.body: The upper Tempering Table slot accepts one vanilla or external-mod weapon, including existing flying swords. The lower slot requires one Yujian flying sword as a spiritual core. External weapons keep their item identity, enchantments, durability and original use action while gaining formations, flight and modules.
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.title: Shaping and Cost
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.body: Open Shaping first. Adjust model axis, glow mode, flip, model scale, aura radius and aura length while watching the preview, then confirm. Every weapon has only two tempering opportunities. Entering immediately consumes levels and destroys the lower core sword; interruptions do not refund them.
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.title: The Spirit Trial
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.body: Attack the dummy with the ritual weapon; the first valid hit starts ten seconds. Vanilla and third-party enchantments remain active while Yujian cores are cleared. Only one channel from that weapon, its traceable projectile, or its single trial sword counts. The DPS becomes intrinsic piercing damage.
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.title: Damage and Settings
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.body: Intrinsic pierce damage drives vanilla melee, while Sharpness, Smite and other enchantments feed back into actual piercing. Potions, accessories and Edge Refinement update it live. Tempering saves an enchantment baseline to prevent double counting; lightning and burst modules are never baked in.
screen.yujiancraft.tempering.ritual_rule: Confirm Shaping first. Entering immediately consumes levels and the core sword; only a ten-second personal trial remains.
